sections.heading: What is collected
sections.content: Only what you type into the contact form: name, email, inquiry type and message.

sections.heading: How it is used
sections.content: Solely to reply to your enquiry. Nothing is sold, rented or shared with advertisers.

sections.heading: Analytics
sections.content: Aggregate, anonymous page-view counts are recorded. No cross-site tracking is used.

sections.heading: Your control
sections.content: Ask for your message data to be deleted at any time and it will be removed within seven days.
